decisions.reason: Results appear satisfactory and the product is close to the firm's established offer, so slack and aspiration logic favor keeping it.
The modular camera is close to proven operations and no shortfall is evident, so the firm has no reason to search for alternatives.
The sensor suite builds on established capabilities, and with industry growth and hiring the firm has slack to carry it while performance remains satisfactory.
Although only mentioned on the website, the LiDAR is close to core optical expertise, and organizational slack supports keeping it while results are still uncertain.
